scripts.build:all: npm run customer:build && npm run admin:build && npm run backend:build
scripts.customer:build: npm --prefix react ci && npm --prefix react run build
scripts.admin:build: npm --prefix admin ci && npm --prefix admin run build
scripts.admin:typecheck: npm --prefix admin ci && npm --prefix admin run typecheck
scripts.backend:build: npm --prefix backend ci && npm --prefix backend run build
scripts.deploy:customer: npm run customer:build && npx wrangler pages deploy react/dist --project-name arenaai
scripts.deploy:admin: npm run admin:build && npx wrangler pages deploy admin/dist --project-name skb-admin
